positions.title: Product
positions.description:
Applied AI & ML Accelerator
Founding member, led technical product and program management. Our mission was to help organizations in Amazon WW Stores increase efficiency and re-envision business processes by accelerating the adoption of AI and ML technologies, in collaboration with AWS; focusing on applying technologies such as deep learning (DL), large language models (LLM), generative AI (GenAI), and agentic AI company wide.  

Worldwide Sustainability
Led product and science team for the NetZero organization  (https://www.amazon.com/sustainability). Our mission was to build products that help Amazon decarbonize its operations by automating the processes of estimating and reporting environmental impact, and by quantifying opportunities to reduce the impact through simulation. We built world-class services, models, and tools that reflected the latest climate change science and translate actuals, estimates, and simulations into actionable insights.

positions.title: Product
positions.description:
Connection Integrity
Worked on improving the quality of the News Feed. We built mechanisms and ML models to classify harmful content along various dimensions, identify bad actors, and act on our classifications.

positions.title: Senior Manager Technical Product and TPM
positions.description:
Last Mile Technology
Led product team for Data Collection and Routing Intelligence, as part of Last Mile Technology. We built systems to collect data and ground truth to help Amazon understand how delivery routes are executed; we used that knowledge and ML and statistical models to improve and optimize future route execution plans for our delivery associates. 

Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems
Built and managed team of technical product and program managers in Seattle and Bangalore. As part of Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) we built a scalable Selection Monitoring platform to automate the understanding of brands and products in eCommerce. Our platform produced data that was used by business and technology teams across Amazon. We ingested and processed semi-structured big data at scale, and leveraged techniques such as deep learning to help make the biggest catalog on the planet even bigger - and more relevant for our customers.

positions.title: Group Product Manager & Senior Manager, Engineering
positions.description:
Computational marketing
Led geographically distributed (US, Germany, Chile) product & engineering teams. Built global high-availability, low-latency services to analyze and influence online consumer behavior in real-time.

positions.title: Senior Program Manager
positions.description:
Online Services Division (OSD)
* Responsible for backend systems and demand side platform (DSP) and ad exchange strategy on Microsoft's Audience Intelligence team. Created and led virtual teams to deliver technology that streamlined campaign management across Microsoft's display advertising platforms and significantly reduced operational costs. Drove the architectural design and managed the release across several teams with minimal interruption across all affected online services. 
* Responsible for delivery engine, APIs, campaign management, and operational features for Microsoft AdECN (real-time bidding ad exchange); led cross-functional team to scale live ad exchange system to production levels; led virtual team to deliver ad exchange solution for mobile devices. Managed and delivered several releases on schedule.

Microsoft Business Solutions (MBS)
* Responsible for programming model with in Dynamics AX related to system integration, including webservice generation. Defined platform APIs for cloud migration of Dynamics. Built early prototypes leveraging social media and O365 to showcase new opportunities for "enterprise social networks" .

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description: First engineer in successful startup company to help get the product defined and started; shipped first couple of releases of new problem resolution management product to paying customers; helped growing both product and company.

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Led engineering team of FTEs and contractors on web services projects (Workshop team). Contributed to JCP/JSR, Apache Software Foundation as committer.

positions.title: SDE II
positions.description: Engineer on the Automated Advertising team; automated generation, management and (performance) analysis for Amazon's Internet ads on Google, Overture, etc.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description: Reported to VP of Advanced Technologies; worked on next generation device drivers, protocol stacks, embedded systems, multimedia transmission (VoIP, Video) and system management solutions.

positions.title: Post-grad Research Assistant
positions.description: PhD student. Researcher on CoBrow project (joint-venture of U Lancaster, ETH Zurich, Uni Ulm), worked on telecollaboration and social networks. Published results at IEEE's SYBEN '98 conference.
